units.source_text: 梅雨连绵，久不放晴；其时宫中正值斋戒期间，不宜出门，人人连日笼闭室内，以避不祥。

en.t: The rainy season dragged on without a clear day for a long time; at that time the court was in a period of ritual purification, when it was not proper to go out, and everyone stayed shut indoors day after day to avoid ill omen.
Prince Genji therefore remained living in the palace for an extended time.

units.source_text: 左大臣家盼待日久，不免怨恨。

en.t: The household of the Minister of the Left waited for him day after day, and could not help feeling resentful.

units.source_text: 然而还是备办种种服饰及珍贵物品，送入宫中供用；左大臣家诸公子也天天到源氏公子的宫中住室淑景舍来奉陪。

en.t: Even so, they prepared all kinds of garments and precious objects and sent them into the palace for his use; the young gentlemen of the Minister of the Left's household also came every day to Shigeisa, Prince Genji's palace residence, to keep him company.

units.source_text: 诸公子中，正夫人所生的那位藏人少将，现已升任头中将[\[4\]](#part1331.html#m4)，此人和源氏公子特别亲昵，每当游戏作乐之时，此人总是最可亲、最熟悉的对手。

en.t: Among those young gentlemen, the Chamberlain Lieutenant born to the principal wife had now been promoted to Captain Secretary[\[4\]](#part1331.html#m4); he was especially close to Prince Genji, and whenever they played games or amused themselves, he was always Genji's most agreeable and familiar companion.

units.source_text: 这头中将与源氏公子相似：右大臣重视他，赘他为婿，但他是个好色之徒，不喜欢去这正夫人家，而把自己家里的房间装饰得富丽堂皇。

en.t: This Captain Secretary resembled Prince Genji: the Minister of the Right valued him and had taken him as a son-in-law, but he was a man fond of love affairs, disliked going to his principal wife's house, and instead decorated the rooms in his own residence with great splendor.

units.source_text: 源氏公子来了，他在此室中招待他；去了，他陪他同行，两人片刻不离。

en.t: When Prince Genji came, he entertained him in these rooms; when Genji went out, he accompanied him, and the two were never apart for even a moment.

units.source_text: 不论昼夜，不论学问或游艺，都两人共同研习。

en.t: Day or night, whether in scholarship or in the arts of amusement, the two studied and practiced everything together.

units.source_text: 他的能耐竟也不亚于源氏公子。

en.t: His abilities, surprisingly, were not inferior to Prince Genji's.

units.source_text: 无论到什么地方，一定相与偕往。

en.t: Wherever they went, they were sure to go together.

units.source_text: 这样，两人自然非常亲爱，相处不拘礼节。

en.t: In this way, the two naturally became very fond of each other and dealt with one another without stiff formality.

units.source_text: 心中感想，也无所不谈了。

en.t: They came to speak freely about everything, even the thoughts hidden in their hearts.
